example.prompt: A middle-aged East Asian man in a slightly rumpled white dress shirt sits alone at a small vintage wooden desk in a quiet study at dusk, facing the camera. He has just heard something that troubles him; over the four-second shot his composed expression slowly gives way without a single large gesture: his gaze drops from the lens toward his own open hands resting palm-up on the desk, the inner corners of his eyebrows rise and pull together forming a faint apologetic crease above the bridge of his nose, his lips press into a thin flat line, his jaw tightens and he swallows once, then a single slow breath parts his lips slightly. His body, shoulders and the desk stay perfectly still throughout; only his face animates. Behind him a wooden bookshelf and a coat hanging on a chair fall into deep shadow while a single warm tungsten desk lamp casts soft side light onto his expression. No camera motion, no walking, no other movement. Cinematic depth of field, photorealistic, 24fps.
